assessment.reading: Interpret sophisticated legal, ethical, human-rights and institutional texts with precision, nuance and source awareness.
assessment.listening: Extract claims, testimony, assumptions, qualifications and implications from expert legal and ethical communication.
assessment.speaking: Present, challenge and negotiate complex rights and justice positions using precise C2+ register and respectful disagreement.
assessment.writing: Produce legal-style analyses, ethical arguments, institutional briefs and evidence-based recommendations with strong cohesion.
assessment.decisionMaking: Evaluate rights, duties, evidence, proportionality, uncertainty and competing institutional interests before recommending action.
assessment.presentation: Communicate complex legal and ethical issues clearly to expert and non-expert audiences while preserving important qualifications.

successCriteria: distinguishes legal fact, evidence, inference, interpretation and normative judgment
uses advanced legal, ethical and human-rights vocabulary accurately and flexibly
handles exceptions, limitations, uncertainty and competing rights with precision
evaluates testimony and evidence without overclaiming
constructs sophisticated arguments using principles, authorities, concessions and rebuttals
shifts naturally between legal, academic, institutional and public registers
negotiates disputes using precise, proportionate and constructive language
produces concise institutional recommendations from complex evidence
responds effectively to high-pressure justice and ethics scenarios
integrates research, listening, analysis, speaking and writing at C2+ level
